body.x: Produce the daily team closing report accurately and on time, from post-close data, so leadership reads one true picture of the day.
The end-of-day Team B closing report. Follows the Reporting & Data Integrity SOP for all method rules.

x: Post-close data only; same-day figures are provisional.
Name concentration risk every time (LPK777 around 45% of team deposit).
No em dashes; no invented numbers.

head: Action
Sequence (when)
Degree / standard
Tool
rows: Weighted: sum depositors / sum population; never average percentages
Section 1 brand order (LPK, BM, HOT, RM, SK, ACE, JK); name concentration risk
Quantify any data-artifact gain; flag cross-day comparisons
Totals reconcile vs the scorecard ledger; no em dashes; submit to the closing file

x: Post-close only; weighted only; missing = dash; concentration risk named.
This SOP fixes the process and integrity. Confirm the exact section list and layout with the current report owner (benchmark, Method 3), then lock it into the report template.
